description: Local config of is-this-backtest-lambo-or-lada. The first-run setup (scripts/triage-config.mjs setup) writes it; keep it outside the skill. Default location: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config, then tradeblocks-skills/is-this-backtest-lambo-or-lada/local-config.json; TRIAGE_CONFIG overrides it. No value here ships with the skill.

costs.file: <path to your cost file in the format of templates/costs.json (Option Omega units)>

notes: Relative paths resolve against this file's folder (after following a symlink); commands run in that folder. costs: give either file or command (argv array that prints the same JSON, e.g. a converter from your own cost file). cost2x: a named scenario, or null for base slippage x 2. thresholds: path of your copy of thresholds.json, or null for the default. protocolHook: argv array called with the run folder as last argument, or null. plugin: {"exists": false}, or {"exists": true, "name": ..., "roles": ["source", "runRequest"] (the ones it does), "skill": <skill name> or "command": [argv]}; with role runRequest the run request is handed to it.
